title: A benchmark for toxic comment classification on Civil Comments dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating Subgroup AUC, BPSN AUC, and BNSP AUC metrics on comments tagged with gender identities (e.g., male, female, transgender) to measure unintended bias.
Calculating Subgroup AUC, BPSN AUC, and BNSP AUC metrics on comments tagged with sexual orientation identities (e.g., heterosexual, homosexual, bisexual) to measure unintended bias.
Calculating Subgroup AUC, BPSN AUC, and BNSP AUC metrics on comments tagged with religious identities (e.g., Christian, Jewish, Muslim) to measure unintended bias.
Calculating Subgroup AUC, BPSN AUC, and BNSP AUC metrics on comments tagged with racial or ethnic identities (e.g., Black, White, Latino) to measure unintended bias.
Calculating Subgroup AUC, BPSN AUC, and BNSP AUC metrics on comments tagged with disability identities (e.g., psychiatric disability) to measure unintended bias.
